coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

actual_deviation.label: Actual schedule deviation and on-time share

predicted_deviation.label: Predicted schedule deviation and prediction revision (last_24h only)

provenance.definition: Predicted schedule deviation and prediction revision (last_24h only)
sql: select line, window_label as window, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then median_predicted_deviation_s end, 2) as median_predicted_deviation_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then p90_predicted_deviation_s end, 2) as p90_predicted_deviation_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then median_abs_revision_s end, 2) as median_abs_revision_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then skipped_share end, 2) as skipped_share, n_eligible as n_observations, round(coverage_pct, 1) as coverage_pct, not (coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50) as withheld from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_line_reliability_window.parquet') where window_label = 'last_24h' and line = 'Green-C' order by line limit 501

select line, window_label as window, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then median_deviation_s end, 2) as median_deviation_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then p90_deviation_s end, 2) as p90_deviation_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then pct_on_time_window end, 2) as pct_on_time_window, n_arrivals as n_observations, round(coverage_pct, 1) as coverage_pct, not (coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50) as withheld from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_actual_deviation_window.parquet') where window_label = 'last_24h' and line = 'Green-C' order by line limit 501
